# Bundled speech recognition model

Speaking Glass transcribes speech on-device using a model it does not own. This file
travels with the model because redistribution requires the attribution to travel
with it, and the upstream archive ships no licence file of its own.

It lives inside the model directory deliberately: the model is fetched rather
than committed (`pnpm models:fetch`), so a notice kept anywhere else would
describe an artefact that may not be present, and would not reach a user who has
only the installed app.

## The model

**X-ASR streaming Zipformer transducer (480 ms chunk, INT8, punctuated)**

- Model: `x-asr-480ms-streaming-zipformer-punct-int8-2026-06-05`
- Languages: en, zh
- Authors: Jun Guo, with the X-LANCE Lab, Shanghai Jiao Tong University
- Source: <https://github.com/Gilgamesh-J/X-ASR>
- Distributed via: <https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx>, as `sherpa-onnx-x-asr-480ms-streaming-zipformer-transducer-zh-en-punct-int8-2026-06-05`
- **Licence: Apache License 2.0** (`Apache-2.0`) — <https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0>

Speaking Glass redistributes these model weights **unmodified**.

## Integrity

The archive these files came from is pinned in the catalogue by SHA-256, and
the fetch refuses to unpack bytes that do not match:

- Archive: `sherpa-onnx-x-asr-480ms-streaming-zipformer-transducer-zh-en-punct-int8-2026-06-05.tar.bz2`
- SHA-256: `fa5f63d618e5a01526e275a358bb7772e403f84808a4769fba52cffd8160bf74`
- Size: 133895136 bytes

## The runtime

Inference runs through **sherpa-onnx** (<https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx>),
Apache-2.0, linked statically via the `sherpa-onnx` Rust crate, which in turn
embeds **ONNX Runtime** (MIT).

## Licence text

The full text of the Apache License 2.0 is in `LICENSE-Apache-2.0.txt`, in this
directory, beside the weights it governs. It is written out at install time rather
than linked, because a URL is not a copy: a machine holding the model offline would
otherwise have the thing the licence covers and not the licence.

The canonical text is also published at <https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0>.
